title: Frukt Cyder Passionfruit Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: A tropical take on an English summer thirst-quencher, Frukt Cyder’s impassioned Passionfruit e-liquid harnesses the fruit’s exotic sweetness and blends it into a crisp, refreshing cider bursting with sunshine. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend strikes the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Nicotine salts are found naturally in tobacco, but their recent introduction to the world of e-liquids has opened up a fantastic new way to beat cravings when used with certain types of e-cigarette kits. Unlike traditional freebase nicotine, nicotine salts have a lower PH level which means that higher levels of nicotine can be vaped at lower temperatures. This eliminates the uncomfortable throat hit you would get if you vaped freebase e-liquid with a higher nicotine concentration. Nicotine Salt e-liquids are perfect for previously heavy smokers used to high nicotine, and can be vaped in low-resistance kits such as pod kits or starter kits .
